title: A late-2025 amendment to California's wealth tax proposal treats founder control as ownership, a move that could end founder-controlled startups in the state (Mike Solana/Pirate Wires)
summary: Mike Solana / Pirate Wires: A late-2025 amendment to California's wealth tax proposal treats founder control as ownership, a move that could end founder-controlled startups in the state — it's not a tax on “wealth,” the union's ballot prop is designed to target the very concept of founder-controlled companies …
